messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: pager: tokenizer-preproc CPU OOMs on cluster inference-prod-2. Multiple pod OOMKilled events, p99 latency spike ~4x, ~30% request 5xx. Affected service: /v1/generate (tokenize stage). Paging on-call: @Priya (oncall).
Priya (oncall): seeing it, joining. any customer reports yet?
Rui (customer-success): one enterprise account reported increased errors and slow responses ~11:02am UTC. Notified that we're investigating.
Priya (oncall): thx. Jamal, can you confirm which node types?
Jamal (sre): checking k8s events now. Looks like preproc pods on nodepool cpu-heavy-8 have OOMKilled and kubelet eviction. Memory usage for tokenizer container hit 98% before OOM.
Priya (oncall): any GPU errors?
Alex (eng-runtime): I see a few CUDA driver WARNs on a separate GPU pool but those are unrelated. This thread is CPU OOM in tokenizer worker containers (Go service). Suspect heavy prompt regex ops and long prefix expansion.
Priya (oncall): good to know. Initial mitigation: scale tokenizer replicas + temporarily remove aggressive regex plugin. Jamal can you bump HPA min to 6 for preproc?
Jamal (sre): bumping now and cordoning the most-faulty node so pods reschedule.
Jamal (sre): `kubectl scale deployment/tokenizer-preproc -n inference --replicas=6` -> applied.
deploy-bot: rollout triggered: tokenizer-preproc to 6 replicas by Jamal.
Priya (oncall): Alex, can we enable the fallback path to the lightweight tokenizer (less memory) for new requests?
Alex (eng-runtime): yes. Pushing a config flag to route heavy prompt users to small-tokenizer-quantized variant. Applying feature-flag: `FEATURE_TOKENIZER_FALLBACK=enabled`
Alex (eng-runtime): pushing quick routing change now. Should be instantaneous.
Priya (oncall): Rui, tell the customer we have a mitigation active and are routing to a smaller tokenizer with minimal quality impact.
Rui (customer-success): pinged customer, they appreciate the rapid response. Asking for ETA to full fix.
Jamal (sre): restarted 3 OOMKilled pods after reschedule. Observed one pod hit oom again after ~2m. Attaching last lines of container log:
```
panic: runtime: out of memory
goroutine 3124 [running]:
main.tokenizeIteration(...)
    /app/tokenize/worker.go:442 +0x1f3
```
Priya (oncall): that stack shows memory hog in tokenizeIteration. Alex, any recent changes to prefix expansion?
Alex (eng-runtime): We shipped a change yesterday that expands user prefixes for relevance scoring — it can blow up memory for pathological prompts (long repeated patterns). Rolling that change back in 30s.
deploy-bot: rollback started for commit 7a4f2c, component: tokenizer-expand.
Priya (oncall): good. Also reduce concurrency in tokenizer pod to avoid OOMs while we stabilize. Jamal, set `TOKENIZER_MAX_CONCURRENCY=4` via patch.
Jamal (sre): patching deployment env -> applied. Pods will restart.
monitoring-bot: alert: tokenization_errors > 5% on /v1/generate -> auto-escalation threshold passed.
Priya (oncall): we're seeing 5xx drop from 30% -> 8% after routing + rollback + concurrency cap. Still some nodes flapping.
Alex (eng-runtime): adding rate-limiter at ingress for known heavy endpoints: `X-Tokenized-Length > 20k` -> 429 for non-enterprise keys. This reduces noisy traffic.
Priya (oncall): Jamal, can you add an ephemeral cgroup soft limit to tokenizer container so OOM kills are less abrupt? We want graceful rejection instead of process OOM.
Jamal (sre): can do, will apply a memory `limits.memory` soft limit (1.5Gi) and allow QoS burst. Applying now.
Jamal (sre): applied limit to deployment. New pods come up with the limit.
Alex (eng-runtime): added additional telemetry to log token length and pattern frequency for any future analysis. Also instrumented a sampling hook to capture offending prompts (PII safe: redacted).
Priya (oncall): customer impact summary so far for ops notes: short errors window ~11:02-11:35am UTC; peak 5xx ~30%; now down to ~2-3%. Partial mitigation in place (fallback tokenizer + rollback + concurrency cap + ingress throttling).
Rui (customer-success): update sent to customer. They requested ETA for permanent fix. Can we estimate?
Alex (eng-runtime): root cause: prefix-expansion change + certain customer prompt patterns causing O(n^2) memory growth in tokenization. Fix options: revert permanent change (we rolled back), add safe-guards in expansion (truncate/stream), and add unit tests for pathological inputs. Time estimate: hotfix patch + tests ~ 4-6 hours, full release with e2e ~ 24-48h.
Priya (oncall): plan: 1) keep fallback routing and concurrency cap 2) keep ingress temp rate-limit 3) cut hotfix to truncate expansion and add safe-guards (Alex) 4) SRE to monitor node stability and scale as needed (Jamal) 5) CS to keep customer informed (Rui).
Priya (oncall): any downstream fallout? Are any other services using the same tokenizer library?
Alex (eng-runtime): yes, some batch jobs use same lib. Will update batch config to opt-out temporarily. Doing now.
Jamal (sre): noticed one GPU node reported `cuda: unable to allocate memory` warnings but no GPU OOM kills. Not impacting current path. I'll file a follow-up.
Priya (oncall): thank you. Handing off to the next on-call in 30m. Please put status in incident tracker.
Jamal (sre): adding timeline + logs to incident ticket INC-240999-1.
Alex (eng-runtime): hotfix branch created: `hotfix/tokenizer-safe-expand`. I will open PR and request quick review.
Rui (customer-success): customer acknowledged and will monitor. They requested a postmortem.
Priya (oncall): assign postmortem to eng-runtime + SRE, link to INC-240999-1, tag severity P2 for now. I'll include remedial checklist: monitoring thresholds, input fuzz tests, cgroup soft-limits, and feature-flag defaults.
incident-bot: incident INC-240999-1 created and assigned.
Priya (oncall): if anything regresses, page me immediately. Otherwise I'll handoff at 11:55am UTC. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Alex (eng-runtime): quick note: pushing hotfix to canary now (2 pods) to validate memory profile.
Jamal (sre): canary shows stable memory under same noisy test. No OOMs observed in 10m.
Priya (oncall): great. leaving notes and moving to monitoring. Handoff to oncall-next in 30m.
Rui (customer-success): I'll prep customer-facing timeline for postmortem.
Priya (oncall): done. Handoff complete. Good job everyone. :party_parrot:
